notes.note: Edited SecretBindingAdministration: resolveOAuthClientSecret, its exact grant, bind/unbind ordering and the oauthClientGrants document field. Checked against secret-binding-administration.ts and its tests. Other inputs: the module map adds only an OAuth client-secret resolver paragraph to SecretBindingAdministration; bind/unbind accept the mcp-integration-oauth-client consumer; station-runtime.ts only passes the secret-binding resolver to the engine MCP OAuth resolver so configured OAuth client secrets can refresh; mcp-manager.ts only passes an integration's configured OAuth client and secret resolver to its remote OAuth providers; mcp-service.ts adds the client-id-required health state, credential reset on OAuth client change, a bound-secret endpoint pin and per-sign-in scopes; the binding authority adds the OAuth client-secret grant, resolver and bind/unbind consumer.
